comment_candidates.draft: Fall Equinox Gala looked like a Main Street win. Cozy season deserves a proper launch party.
A hand-lettered pumpkin spice sign in Grand Junction. Autumn is officially open for business.
Goth Prom at a coffee shop is an inspired venue choice. Black eyeliner and espresso, perfect pairing.
Closing for your own wedding is the best possible reason to skip a shift. Congratulations to Mrs. Jitterz.
Fall feelings, iced coffee loyalty. Some of us refuse to switch to hot no matter the season.
Yellow eyelet maxi dress energy all day. Happy birthday Taylor, clearly the boutique favorite.
Three dress watches on varsity jackets is a bold styling choice. Respect the confidence.
Co-hosting a gala and keeping spines aligned. Multitasking at its most Grand Junction.
Two big releases on the same Tuesday. Booksellers live for this chaos.
Room for rent is the entrepreneur starter pack. Somebody's spa empire begins here.
Those dark wood beams against white stucco are doing serious work. Timeless is right.
A creepy doll class is the most October-coded workshop possible. Incredible commitment to the bit.
Soft glam that survives a whole wedding day. The florals in the updo are a nice touch.
That pancake spread could convert a brunch skeptic. Sunday traditions earned, not inherited.
The oversized puffer vest is fall's official uniform. Grand Junction winters demand the drama.

voice: under-20-words, funny-first, punchy, expert/techy but down to earth, post-specific; no sell, no PING, no links, no contact info, no customer-posing, no em dashes
